mapper.select: SELECT ur.relation_id AS relationId, ur.target_type AS targetType, ar.role_type AS targetRoleType, ar.external_id AS roleExternalId, ar.name AS roleName, ar_rel.external_id AS relationExternalId, ur.valid_from AS validFrom, ur.valid_to AS validTo FROM user_role ur LEFT JOIN abstract_role ar ON ur.target_id = ar.id AND ar.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ar.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN abstract_role ar_rel ON ur.relation_id = ar_rel.id AND ar_rel.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND ar_rel.delete_flag = 0 WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.abstract_user_id = #{abstractUserId} AND ur.delete_flag = 0 AND (ur.valid_from <= #{now} OR ur.valid_from IS NULL) AND (ur.valid_to >= #{now} OR ur.valid_to IS NULL)
